errors.what: Foot x/y panel values jump discontinuously (foot_x 97 mm at 60 deg, -431 mm at 90 deg, -54 mm at 120 deg; -265 mm at 270 deg, +337 mm at 300 deg, +50 mm at 330 deg), which is impossible for a continuous 30-degree crank step. This indicates the solver flips assembly branch (wrong configuration) at some angles.

Linkage shape changes drastically between frames, with the leg triangle flipping orientation and links crossing and overlapping, not the smooth Jansen leg. The foot trace is a mass of long straight spikes rather than the characteristic flat-bottomed closed loop, so the foot path is wrong.
